content:
We got templates. Need template IDs (reaction_id). Use those IDs as template_id in JSON. For amide formation, reaction_id 1300219 seems appropriate: acyl chloride + amine -> amide. Use that.

Now need Heck coupling template: aryl bromide + alkene -> trans-aryl-alkene. Search.


<thought>Search for a Heck coupling template that breaks an aryl halide (aryl bromide) and forms a C=C bond between aryl and alkene.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(Cl)cc1C=CC(=O)Nc2ccccc2N",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
